method: Mix the masa harina and measured water into a dough. Scrape dry patches from the bowl into the mixture and work them in with your hands. Divide into two, press between non-stick sheets and dry-cook in a hot pan for 1–2 minutes per side.

method: Blend the pepper, coriander, garlic and all the measured water. Put in a small pan with the dry rice and half the oil. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook gently for 15–18 minutes until tender. Look for small, gentle bubbles rather than a rolling boil. Stir along the bottom when needed to prevent sticking, and keep the heat low enough for the food to cook evenly. Rest covered for 5 minutes.

Brush the cod with one quarter of the oil and half the lime juice. Bake at 200°C, or 180°C fan, for 12–15 minutes until opaque, steaming hot and flaking easily. Check the centre as well as the surface; a browned top alone does not show that the inside is cooked.

Mix the mayonnaise, remaining oil and remaining lime juice. Toss with the shredded cabbage and carrot. Serve all the fish and edible baking juices with all the green rice, slaw and weighed avocado flesh.

unchangedRecipeFields.name: Black-bean and rice stuffed peppers
unchangedRecipeFields.description: Baked peppers filled with black beans, rice and spices, with melted Cheddar and avocado.
unchangedRecipeFields.equipment: Kitchen scales, Oven, Grater, Lid or bowl cover, Ovenproof dish, Saucepan, Frying pan

ingredients.item: Black beans, boiled without salt and drained
ingredients.shoppingItem: Black beans, boiled without salt and drained

ingredients.item: Hass avocado flesh, skin and stone removed
ingredients.shoppingItem: Hass avocado flesh, skin and stone removed

method: Heat the oven to 200°C, or 180°C fan. Halve and deseed the peppers and weigh the edible halves. Brush with half the oil and bake for 15 minutes. Check the centre as well as the surface; a browned top alone does not show that the inside is cooked.

Cook the rice with all the measured water in a covered pan for 12–15 minutes, then rest for 5 minutes. Keep the heat low enough that the rice cooks steadily rather than boiling over. At the end, check that a grain is tender right through, then let the rice rest as directed before loosening it with a fork.

Soften chopped onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes. Stir around the base and edges of the pan. The vegetables should soften and lose their raw bite; lower the heat if they start to darken before they are tender. Add cumin, paprika, chopped tomato and cooked drained black beans. Cook for 5 minutes, then fold in all the rice. Use a fork or broad spoon and a light lifting motion so the grains stay separate.

Fill both pepper halves, spooning any extra filling around them. Top with all the grated Cheddar and bake for 15–20 minutes until the peppers are tender and the filling is steaming hot. Serve the entire dish with all the weighed avocado flesh, lime juice and coriander.
Use vegetarian-rennet cheese for the vegetarian version specified here.

unchangedRecipeFields.name: Turkey patties with avocado and cabbage salad
unchangedRecipeFields.description: Cumin-spiced turkey patties with a crunchy cabbage, avocado and lemon salad.
unchangedRecipeFields.equipment: Kitchen scales, Knife and chopping board, Mixing bowl, Frying pan, Food thermometer

ingredients.item: Fresh raw egg white, separated from shell eggs
ingredients.shoppingItem: Fresh raw egg white, separated from shell eggs

ingredients.item: Hass avocado flesh, skin and stone removed
ingredients.shoppingItem: Hass avocado flesh, skin and stone removed

method: Mince plain skinless turkey breast at home. Mix with the egg white, cumin, half the parsley and pepper. Shape into four thin patties.

Heat three fifths of the oil in a non-stick pan and cook the patties for 5–6 minutes per side until the centres reach 75°C for 30 seconds. Leave space between the portions and let the underside set before moving them. Slide a thin spatula underneath and turn carefully, keeping each portion together.
Toss shredded cabbage and weighed avocado flesh with the remaining oil, lemon juice and parsley. Serve all the patties, edible pan juices and salad.
